title: Golf-Swing Consistency by Club
dataSources: Bar-velocity reps (`vbt:rep`), running gait (`gait:metric`), hangboard sessions (`hangboard:session`), golf-swing metrics (`golfswing:metric`), power-meter intervals (`powermeter:interval`), basketball shot arcs (`shotarc:make`).
app: Sports and skill sensors — velocity-based-training bar trackers, running-form IMUs, climbing hangboard load cells, golf launch monitors, cycling power meters, and computer-vision shot trackers — logged to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=golfswing:metric
| stats avg(carry_m) as carry, stdev(carry_m) as carry_sd, avg(club_speed_kmh) as speed by club
| eval consistency=round(carry_sd,1)
| sort - consistency
description: Measures how consistent your carry distance is with each club so you know which yardages you can actually trust on the course.
value: Golf is a game of dispersion; knowing the spread per club turns club selection from hope into a confident, data-backed decision.
implementation: Ingest launch-monitor data into `index=personal`; review carry consistency per club.
visualization: Bar chart of carry-distance variation by club.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how consistent your distance is with each golf club, so you know which ones you can rely on.
